dataset_title: HPT / Long Hau scanned cover page 1 OCR check
purpose: Full-page CER/WER check for one visually reviewed page from the scanned HPT PDF.
reference_method: manual visual transcription from the rendered source page
limitations: One cover page only; this is not representative of the 22-page PDF or a production corpus.
The transcription includes printed words and excludes decorative line art and the non-text Ernst & Young logo mark.
CER/WER cannot establish layout detection quality or table extraction accuracy.
